About The Team

ArcaLabs builds AI agents that perform sell-side tasks (public comps, IC memos, pitchbook strip profiles, earnings comp analysis) end-to-end. We're partnered with some of the largest financial data providers, including FactSet and CapIQ. Our founding team previously built Arcafeed, a SaaS tool for buy-side analysts, which was acquired in late 2025.

About The Role

We're hiring SWE interns to ship code into production from day one. Timing is flexible: internships run 10–12+ weeks, and we'll work around your school calendar. You'll sit with the founding team in Palo Alto, own real components of the platform, and see your work running inside top-tier banks before your internship ends.

This is not a coffee-fetching internship. The bar for our interns is the bar for our full-time engineers, and the same is true for the work and the trust. Our interns have owned meaningful parts of our product, including deep systems work like Hardpan.

Some of the work you'll do



- Own a meaningful chunk of our agent runtime: retrieval, memory, evals, or the data pipelines behind them.
- Build infrastructure for our agents and agentic workflows: sandboxes, VMs, lifecycle management, observability, and more.
- Work on evals and observability for our agents, so that we can ship better agents faster.
- Pair with Forward Deployed Engineers on a real customer deployment, sometimes inside the customer's office.
- Ship production code.
- Help us figure out which intern will get a strong return offer, by being that intern.

You might be a fit if you



- Are a current undergraduate or graduate student in CS, math, physics, or a similar quantitative field.
- Have shipped a non-trivial software project: open source, side project, course capstone, or prior internship.
- Are comfortable in Python and TypeScript, or fluent in Python plus another typed language. Our entire control plane is TypeScript.
- Read papers on agents, distributed systems, or model post-training for fun.
- Want to live in Palo Alto for the internship and ship full-time, on-site.

Bonus points



- Have built with agent SDKs: tool use, streaming, sub-agents, sandboxed execution.
- Prior experience building with systems languages like Go or Rust.
- Background in finance, even if it's just a markets class, a trading bot, or a hedge fund summer.
- Have built a production-quality side project with real users.

Compensation

Competitive intern hourly rate and housing stipend. Our team is based in Palo Alto, and interns work on-site with us. Strong return offer pipeline for new-grad full-time roles.

About ArcaLabs

ArcaLabs is the official FactSet AI Partner, building AI agents that run sell-side workflows for investment banks and PE funds. We're the team behind Arcafeed (acquired) and we're hiring the founding squad in Palo Alto. We believe AI will widen, not narrow, the set of people who can do high-end finance work. We want to ship that future.

Equal opportunity

ArcaLabs is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on merit, and we accommodate applicants with disabilities. If you need accommodation during the hiring process, email careers@arcalabs.ai.

Apply now
fit_why: Agent infra and evals; strong TypeScript/Python fit, but finance-heavy and systems-leaning

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption.
 
You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimized, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date.
 
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three.
 
Join us if you want to learn how modern data systems work from the inside and apply that knowledge to consequential problems.


Technologies We Use:
• Java, Scala, Rust, and Python 

• Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, Apache Comet, and Velox for data processing and query execution 

• Apache Iceberg for table management and catalog interoperability 

• Apache Arrow and Apache Parquet for in-memory data processing and columnar storage 

• Gradle and Cargo for builds, and GitHub for collaboration 

 You do not need prior experience with these technologies. We expect you to learn them here.

What We Value:
• Curiosity about how data systems work, from query optimizers and execution operators to file formats and distributed processing 

• A high bar for correctness and a willingness to dig until you understand why something behaves the way it does 

• Comfort following a problem across languages, services, and layers of the stack 

• A practical approach to performance, grounded in measurement rather than intuition 

• Eagerness to learn, ask questions, and incorporate feedback 

• Interest in applying deep systems engineering to real-world problems, with empathy for the people who depend on our software

What We Require:
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience 

• Proficiency in at least one language such as Java, Rust, Scala, C++, or C 

• Strong foundations in algorithms, data structures, and concurrency 

• Strong written and verbal communication skills 

• Coursework or projects in databases, compilers, operating systems, or distributed systems 

• Contributions to open-source projects 

• Must be planning on graduating in 2028. This should be your final internship before graduating.

Salary
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $10,500/month. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.


Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.
